Remote DAQ and valve control

Arbalest Rocketry · [MM/YYYY] – Present

A remote data acquisition and control system for the team’s propulsion test stand, so valves can be operated and data logged from a safe distance. It controls seven valves:

  • 2 dump valves
  • 1 LOX fill valve
  • 2 vent valves (ethanol and LOX)
  • 2 run valves

The electronics live in a control cabinet with a LabJack T7, Automation Direct P1AM modules, terminal blocks and a DIN-rail power supply.

About

I study Space Engineering at York University’s Lassonde School of Engineering and work on propulsion and data acquisition with Arbalest Rocketry. I’m a member of the Canadian Association of Rocketry and working toward my Level 1 high-power certification. I also teach swimming and ran STEM camps, so I’m used to explaining technical things clearly. I’m looking for an engineering internship.
